name: sec-vuln-research
description: Multi-stage LLM-driven pipeline for finding, validating, and operationalizing security vulnerabilities in source code. Includes three coordinated skills: sec-vuln-research (full pipeline orchestrator), sec-vuln-triage (three-lens adversarial verifier with code-computed tallies), and sec-attack-chain (attack chain + PoC + machine-readable validation plan). Verification claims, budget limits, dedup, and report integrity are enforced by bundled scripts (triage_tally.py, session_state.py, render_report.py, finding_id.py, ci_gate.py), not by the model. Outputs a validated report (YAML + Markdown), SARIF v2.1.0 with taint codeFlows, and validation-plan.json for downstream DAST/fuzz validation that closes the evidence ladder to exploit_demonstrated.
author: Hecber Cordova
